description: Sends a consultation or property enquiry to the platform's consultants on behalf of a user who has given explicit consent. Returns a reference only.

consent.description: Must be true: the user explicitly agreed that these details are sent to the platform's consultants and stored under its privacy policy.

country.description: Country of residence or nationality, if known.

email.description: The user's e-mail address, where the consultant will reply.

message.description: What the user wants (consultation, viewing, details) and any context they shared: family size, budget, timing, property route.

phone.description: Phone number with country code, if the user wants a call or WhatsApp.

property_reference.description: Listing reference (e.g. P-1206) when the enquiry is about a specific property.

name: submit_enquiry
title: Submit an enquiry
